name: ANTIPYRINUM
key_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting; burning and pain.
Throbbing headache; sensation of constriction. Flashes of heat. Headache under ears with earache.
Fluent coryza. Nasal mucous membrane swollen. Dull pains in frontal sinus. Aphonia. Oppression and dyspnśa. Cheyne-Stokes respiration.
Faintness, with sensation of stoppage of heart. Throbbing throughout the body. Rapid, weak, irregular pulse.
Nerves.--Epileptiform seizures. Contractures. Trembling and cramps. Crawling and numbness. General prostration.
guiding_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting; burning and pain.
Throbbing headache; sensation of constriction. Flashes of heat. Headache under ears with earache.
mind_symptoms: Fear of becoming insane; nervous anxiety; hallucinations of sight and hearing.
head_symptoms: Throbbing headache; sensation of constriction. Flashes of heat. Headache under ears with earache.
respiratory_symptoms: Fluent coryza. Nasal mucous membrane swollen. Dull pains in frontal sinus. Aphonia. Oppression and dyspnśa. Cheyne-Stokes respiration.
gi_symptoms: Nausea and vomiting; burning and pain.
urinary_symptoms: Itching and burning in vagina. Menses suppressed. Watery leucorrhśa.
skin_symptoms: Erythema, eczema, pemphigus. Intense pruritus. Urticaria, appearing and disappearing suddenly, with internal coldness. Angioneurotic-śdema. Dark blotches on skin of penis, sometimes with śdema.
